v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

text.la: Ipse præíbit * ante illum in spíritu et virtúte Elíæ paráre Dómino plebem perféctam.
text.en: He shall go before Him * in the spirit and power of Elias, to make ready a people prepared for the Lord.

text.la: Ioánnes * est nomen eius: vinum et síceram non bibet, et multi in nativitáte eius gaudébunt.
text.en: His name is John. * He shall drink neither wine nor strong drink, and many shall rejoice at his birth.

text.la: Ex útero senectútis * et stérili Ioánnes natus est, præcúrsor Dómini.
text.en: Elizabeth was barren and well stricken in years, * but from her womb was born John the Fore-runner of the Lord.

text.la: Iste puer * magnus coram Dómino: nam et manus eius cum ipso est.
text.en: The child shall be great * in the sight of the Lord, for His hand is with him.

text.la: Nazarǽus * vocábitur puer iste: vinum et síceram non bibet, et omne immúndum non manducábit ex útero matris suæ.
text.en: The child shall be called a Nazarite. * He shall drink neither wine nor strong drink, neither shall he eat any unclean thing, even from his mother's womb.

text.la: Audíte, ínsulæ, et atténdite, pópuli de longe: Dóminus ab útero vocávit me, de ventre matris meæ recordátus est nóminis mei.
text.en: Give ear, ye islands, and hearken, ye people from afar. The Lord hath called me from the womb, from the bowels of my mother he hath been mindful of my name.

v.en: There was a man sent from God.

text.la: Ingrésso * Zacharía templum Dómini, appáruit ei Gábriel Angelus stans a dextris altáris incénsi.
text.en: When Zacharias went * into the Temple of the Lord, the Angel Gabriel appeared unto him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

text.la: Deus, qui præséntem diem honorábilem nobis in beáti Ioánnis nativitáte fecísti: da pópulis tuis spirituálium grátiam gaudiórum; et ómnium fidélium mentes dírige in viam salútis ætérnæ.
text.en: O God, Who hast made this day to be honourable in our eyes because of the Birth of the blessed John, graciously quicken thy people with spiritual joy, and order the minds of all the faithful in the way of everlasting salvation.
